newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldier wounded in West Bank shooting.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier wounded in West Bank shooting.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was shot and wounded near the West Bank town of Hebron in an apparent drive-by attack on Friday, Israel Radio and Jewish settlers said.
They said the soldier was "moderately" wounded. He was guarding the Jewish Har Hamasa settlement south of Hebron, a volatile town split since January between Israeli and Palestinian control.
No further details were immediately available.
